facts.fact: NITA-U's strategic plan reports the National Data Centre in operation, with an average uptime of 99.5% in FY2023/24, and NITA-U selling co-location and data centre services to MDAs, local governments and private clients (data centre services revenue UGX 2.54 billion forecast for FY2024/25).

The plan describes the National Data Centre and its recovery site as critical ICT infrastructure NITA-U, the Government of Uganda's IT authority, established with Government of Uganda and World Bank funding, and NITA-U runs and sells services from it, remitting its revenue to the Government's Consolidated Fund.

The National Data Centre, run by NITA-U, hosted a cumulative 305 applications from 100 entities (ministries, departments, agencies and local governments) by the close of the strategic cycle; the plan also notes only 40% of the 250-entity enrolment target was reached.
